description: Generate Scala 3 models, HTTP server routes, clients, and validators from OpenAPI 3.0 or 3.1, or generate models from JSON Schema.
rules: Use Scala 3 for generated code. Launch the OpenAPI4s CLI with Scala 2.13 or use the OpenAPI4s plugin for the project's existing build tool.
Match the model backend to the application. Use Circe with http4s or Iron, and Tupson with Sharaf or Validson. The sttp client works with either model backend.
Use an OpenAPI document to generate server routes or clients. For standalone JSON Schema files, directories, or HTTP(S) URLs, generate models only and omit --framework and --client.
Regenerate into the same source folder and package to merge additive API changes while preserving handwritten method bodies. Review and remove obsolete Scala code after renames or removals.
Implement generated route bodies and any generated query decoder placeholders before deploying the server. Compile the generated sources with the application's backend dependencies.
